Low volume isn't empty. It's a WALL. ⚠️

A low volume node is a price where almost nothing traded: one side was in full control and price ripped through it in minutes. It is the border between two value areas, not a "gap" that is easy to cross. On NQ, price dropped through 24,480 and built new value at 24,420-24,440. When it rallied back, the footprint printed 3 stacked sell imbalances at the LVN (sellers hitting the bid 3x or more the ask one tick above), delta -645, and price could not hold above 24,480. That is rejection, not weakness.

1️⃣ Mark the LVN edges between value areas on your volume profile
2️⃣ Fast poke + stacked sell imbalances + negative delta = rejection
3️⃣ Time + volume building at the LVN = acceptance: then the rejection idea is invalid
